title: Substitute a named square function
description: You can compare two forms of the projectile calculation.

steps.description: The code binds v0 to 3, t to 5, and a to 9.80665.
square multiplies its argument by itself.
The first expression computes v0 times t plus one half of a times t squared.

steps.question: Will replacing (* t t) with (square t) change the value?
steps.answer: Both forms return 137.583125 because square computes the same multiplication.

steps.description: The second expression uses the named function in the same position. The two displayed results agree.
